editorial:
Imagine being a detective who takes a side job to make some extra cash, only to have it blow up in your face. That is exactly what happens to Seon-woo. He gets hired by a gorgeous woman named Soo-Jin to catch her husband cheating. It seems like an easy payday until he arrives at the scene and finds a dead body instead of a cheating spouse. Suddenly, the hunter becomes the hunted. You get to watch him scramble to clear his name while another cop, Gil-ro, is breathing down his neck. It is a wild ride that mixes a dark crime plot with some funny moments and a lot of tension.

What really makes this work is how the movie keeps you guessing about who is lying. The acting is solid, and the pace stays quick so you never get bored. While some of the plot twists might feel a bit sudden, the overall energy keeps you hooked. If you enjoy movies where a regular guy gets caught in a giant lie, you will love this. It looks great in high definition, making the chase scenes feel even more real.
endingExplained: The big twist reveals that Soo-Jin was not a victim at all, but the mastermind behind the whole plan. She manipulated Seon-woo to make him look like the killer so she could get away with the crime and the money. After a tense showdown, the truth comes out about her real motives. Seon-woo manages to outsmart her and clear his name, finally proving that he was just a pawn in her dangerous game.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves mystery thrillers with a twist.
